notes.subject: וקרא עליה
notes.rationale: autim tok long en — Hebrew על 'against/in opposition to', not merely 'unto' as some render.

notes.subject: עלתה רעתם
notes.rationale: evil 'goes up' before Yahwe — same verb as Jonah going down to flee; ascent/descent contrast, lost in Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: to Jonah
notes.rationale: Imperative summons: kirap, go — divine command addressing Jonah directly.

translation: Kirap, go long Ninve, ⟨i⟩ bikpela siti, na autim tok olgeta long en, bilong ol i no stret, bilong olgeta ol i bin bagarapim ol samting i no stret i go antap long bilong Yahwe.

tokens.gloss: ol i bagarapim ol samting i no stret
